snapshots.title: The Stillwater Hotel
snapshots.body:
GUESTBOOK

住客留言

感谢各位住客留下入住感受。

L. Chen
2006-09-08 10:26

我们只住了一晚。房间挺安静的，早上到湖边走了走。前台帮忙找到了忘在餐厅的围巾，谢谢。

M. Cooper
2006-09-24 16:11

庭院比照片里小一点，不过天气好的时候坐着很舒服。早餐的面包不错。

H. Wong
2006-10-09 08:48

到得太晚了，本来怕没人。前台还亮着灯，办入住很快。下次希望能多待两天。

S. Reed
2006-10-12 12:07

二楼那边走路会听到一点木地板的声音，不过总体挺不错。大堂的旧照片很好看。

R. Bennett
2006-10-15 09:10

早餐挺不错。我们到得很晚，前台还在，挺方便的。

E. Vale
2006-10-17 02:40

已正常入住。

J. Park
2006-10-18 08:15

双床房还可以。早上坐在院子里很舒服。

snapshots.title: The Stillwater Hotel
snapshots.body:
GUESTBOOK

Guestbook

Thank you to our guests for sharing their stays.

L. Chen
2006-09-08 10:26

We only stayed one night. The room was quiet and we walked by the lake in the morning. Thank you to reception for finding the scarf we left in the dining room.

M. Cooper
2006-09-24 16:11

The courtyard is a little smaller than it looks in the pictures, but lovely to sit in when the weather is good. Nice bread at breakfast.

H. Wong
2006-10-09 08:48

We arrived very late and were worried no one would be there. The reception light was on and check-in was quick. Hope to stay longer next time.

S. Reed
2006-10-12 12:07

Some creaking from the wooden floor on the second floor, but a good stay overall. Loved the old photographs in the lobby.

R. Bennett
2006-10-15 09:10

A good breakfast and helpful arrangements for our late arrival. Thank you.

E. Vale
2006-10-17 02:40

Checked in normally.

View historical copy →
·
Reception note: passage cameras restored →
Read reception’s attachment

Noted. The booking assignment is unchanged; we are checking the key sleeve. The floor records from that date are retained with the entry.

Third-floor plan →
J. Park
2006-10-18 08:15

A tidy twin room. The courtyard was a pleasant place to sit in the morning.
